game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the relic hunter must hold off stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Crypt Stairs.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Crypt Stairs. Then check capacity and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ancient lock from stone sentinels in Crypt Stairs: keep capacity above zero until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 9, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
